text: Pointed AC1 at TestInstallPreservesEverythingItDidNotAdd, the same test as AC2. AC1 says the system provides a command that installs its hook configuration; that test asserts pawl's entry is merged into the user's settings alongside what was already there, which is AC1's substance. The CLI wrapper itself is exercised by TestCLIEveryCommandRuns. A weaker link than the other twenty.
